title: Anvil run stream (schema version 1)
description: One ordered event stream within a run. Sequences are per stream; there is no global total order across streams.

parent_stream_id.description: Parent stream for nested agents or parallel branches.

logical_path.description: Stable logical invocation path used for fixture matching, e.g. "/agent/a/tool/0".

last_sequence.description: Highest sequence observed on this stream; -1 when no events have been recorded.

open.description: True while the stream may still accept events; false once it reached a terminal event.
